pcs.pc_description: carry out the line walk within the assigned pipeline spread
describe the type of hydrocarbon products which flow through a pipeline
inspect soil/ground surface condition on and adjacent to pipeline/Right of Uses (ROU)
check for any leakages, construction activity, encroachment and any other factors affecting the safety and security of pipeline
check for any growth of vegetation within the pipeline which could cause leakage
inspect vulnerable locations (river crossings, all cased crossing/railway/canal crossings, encroachments, excavation, exposure etc.) with special care
identify the type of pipeline markers
check if the pipeline markers are indicated at appropriate junctures i.e. Test Lead Point (TLP) Box, warning board, direction board, vent pipe etc.
check the condition of markers (missing, rusted, damaged or requires paint)
detect the leakage using Lower Explosive Limit (LEL) gas detector
check GPS and walkie-talkie are in working conditions
use GPS tagging technology for reporting discrepancies to the control room
prepare inspection report and submit it to the reporting authority
